usage: forge [-h]
             {worldgen,generate-world,simulate-world,validate-world,generate-bible,reconcile-world,generate-narrative,validate-project,validate-package,inspect-package,generate,download-models,resume,config,verify,info,package,validate-story,validate-graph,validate-all,validate-bible}
             ...

StoryTeller Forge — AI-powered interactive story generator

positional arguments:
  {worldgen,generate-world,simulate-world,validate-world,generate-bible,reconcile-world,generate-narrative,validate-project,validate-package,inspect-package,generate,download-models,resume,config,verify,info,package,validate-story,validate-graph,validate-all,validate-bible}
                        Commands
    worldgen            World generation tools
    generate-world      Generate authoritative physical-world artifacts
                        without AI
    simulate-world      Run deterministic civilization and history simulation
    validate-world      Validate and replay a generated historical world
    generate-bible      Generate and reconcile a Bible from an immutable world
    reconcile-world     Reconcile a Bible against its authoritative world
    generate-narrative  Generate referenced narrative, mandatory media, and GM
                        index
    validate-project    Validate a provisional Phase 5 narrative project
    validate-package    Validate a frozen .story v2 package
    inspect-package     Inspect an accepted .story v2 package
    generate            Run the full pipeline
    download-models     Download GGUF models
    resume              Resume from checkpoint
    config              Show/edit configuration
    verify              Verify .story hash
    info                Show checkpoint/state info
    package             Package into .story
    validate-story      Story vs bible consistency
    validate-graph      Validate graph schema
    validate-all        Validate all artifacts in a dir
    validate-bible      Validate bible schema

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
